items.name: Sunrise Skillet (Classic Egg & Bacon)
items.description: Two eggs cooked your way, served alongside three slices of thick-cut hickory-smoked bacon. Comes with a generous heap of our seasoned cast-iron potatoes and a slice of buttery Texas toast to sop it all up.

items.name: Bunkhouse Breakfast (Sausage-Based Plate)
items.description: Two griddle-seared country sausage links, two eggs cooked your way and a pile of crispy hash browns.

items.name: Gold Pan Flapjacks
items.description: A short stack of three massive, fluffy buttermilk pancakes with crisped, buttery edges. Served hot off the griddle with a side of maple syrup and whipped butter.

items.name: Cattle Baron's Dip (Beef Sandwich)
items.description: Slow-roasted, thinly sliced beef brisket piled high on a toasted sourdough roll and topped with melted provolone cheese. Served with a side of savory, slow-simmered au jus for dipping.

items.name: Stagecoach Club (Turkey/Ham Sandwich)
items.description: Roasted turkey breast, smoked ham, sharp cheddar and crispy bacon, all layered between three thick slices of toasted sourdough with mayo, lettuce and tomato.

items.name: Gold Rush BLT
items.description: A small mountain of thick-cut bacon, fresh lettuce, crispy fried green tomatoes and house-made smoky pepper mayo served on toasted, thick-cut wheat bread.

items.name: Trail Boss Pulled Pork
items.description: Tender, slow-smoked pulled pork tossed in tangy western BBQ sauce. Served on a toasted brioche bun and crowned with a scoop of creamy house-made coleslaw.

items.name: Trailblazer Ribeye
items.description: A 16-ounce hand-cut ribeye steak, generously seasoned and grilled over an open flame exactly to your liking. Served with a loaded baked potato and a side of seasonal vegetables.

items.name: Smokey Mountain Ribs
items.description: A hearty half-rack of slow-cooked pork ribs that fall right off the bone, smothered in tangy western BBQ sauce. Served with campfire baked beans and a warm cornbread muffin.

items.name: Homestead Skillet Fried Chicken
items.description: Half a chicken, buttermilk-battered and fried to a golden, crunchy perfection in a traditional cast-iron skillet. Accompanied by creamy mashed potatoes drowning in peppery country gravy.

items.name: Campfire Baked Beans
items.description: Slow-simmered navy beans cooked thick and rich with molasses, brown sugar and savory bacon ends.

items.name: Cast-Iron Potatoes
items.description: Rustic diced potatoes, pan-fried in cast iron wiht onions, bell peppers and our house-blend of western seasonings.

items.name: Wagon Wheel Onion Rings
items.description: Thick-cut sweet onion rings, heavily battered and fried to a deep golden brown. Served with a side of smoky pepper mayo for dipping.

items.name: Warm Buttermilk Cornbread
items.description: Two thick squares of sweet, crumbly cornbread baked fresh daily. Served warm with a generous side of whipped honey butter.

items.name: Campfire Roast Coffe
items.description: A bottomless mug of our signature dark roast. Brewed strong, rich and piping hot.

items.name: Homestead Sweet Tea
items.description: Freshly brewed black tea served ice-cold in a mason jar, sweetened just right with pure cane sugar and served with a wedge of fresh lemon.
